create_deferred_module: create a Deferred module that lazily constructs a Haiku Linear layer using a factory lambda
build_deferred_with_call_methods: build a Deferred module with custom call_methods like encode and decode to trigger construction
access_deferred_target: access the target property of a Deferred instance to force lazy module construction
call_deferred_module: call a Deferred module instance which triggers factory construction and delegates to the target
review_deferred_getattr_proxy: review the Deferred class __getattr__ method that proxies attribute access to the materialized target module
